name_original: Acer - Iconia Tab 8 - 8" - Intel Atom - 16GB - Silver
description_original: Acer Iconia Tab 8: Stay productive and entertained wherever you go with this tablet, which features an 8" touch screen that lets you browse the Web and swipe through features using all 10 fingers. Plus, snap photos of important moments and video chat with loved ones using the 5.0MP rear-facing and 0.3MP front-facing cameras.
